name: Support Helpdesk Ticket System Lite
author: M. Ali Saleem

sections.description:
Host a complete helpdesk and support ticket system on your WordPress site.
Multi Helpdesk lets companies join your site and run their own support desks – each with its own branding, agents, customers and ticket queue.

General

  • Modern React powered helpdesk front-end (single page app)
  • Fully responsive on desktop, tablet and mobile
  • Unlimited companies / helpdesks on one WordPress install
  • Optional company subdomains
  • 6 colour theme presets (Default, Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Royal, Slate)
  • Changeable helpdesk name and front-end URL slug
  • Usage documentation
  • Developer documentation (REST API)
  • Extendable with hooks and filters
  • Optional legacy PHP themes (Blue-Line, Core-UI, Style)

Ticketing

  • Ticket statuses: Opened / Closed
  • Action statuses: Un-Answered / Answered / Solved
  • Assign tickets to agents
  • Departments per ticket
  • Search, status filters and pagination
  • Bulk delete
  • 1 to 5 star customer ratings
  • File attachments on tickets

Company Admin

  • Create unlimited helpdesks
  • Configure the support homepage (introduction and FAQ, HTML allowed)
  • Configure departments
  • Configure extra notification recipients
  • Configure tickets per page
  • Add and remove agents by email
  • View, block and unblock customers (with reason)
  • Reply to tickets and assign them to agents
  • Set ticket status and action status
  • Per-company custom CSS and JavaScript
  • 12 editable email notification templates with short tags
  • Full company settings panel

Admin Panel Demo

Public and Customer

  • Public ticket submission (guest or logged in)
  • Company introduction and FAQ accordion on the ticket form
  • Self registration and login
  • Customer dashboard with ticket statistics
  • My Tickets list with search, status filters and pagination
  • Ticket detail with the full conversation thread
  • Solve and rate resolved tickets
  • Profile management (display name and password)

Customer Panel Demo

Agent

  • Agent dashboard
  • Reply to and close tickets
  • View and manage customers
  • Profile management

Dashboards and Statistics

  • Admin dashboard with total, new, opened, closed, un-answered, answered, solved and rated counters
  • Unassigned ticket counter
  • Recent tickets list
  • Agent and customer totals
  • Per-agent ticket statistics

Limits and Access Control

  • Optional limits for helpdesks per user, and tickets, agents and customers per helpdesk (0 = unlimited)
  • Admin Only Creation mode – restrict helpdesk creation to WordPress administrators
  • Role based access: WordPress administrator, company admin, agent, customer, guest
  • Cookie and nonce REST authentication
  • Per-company data isolation

Coming Soon – Pro Upgrade

The Pro upgrade is in active development. It will unlock:

  • Notifications – SMS, WhatsApp, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, Discord, web push and premium email delivery (SendGrid, Mailgun, Amazon SES, Postmark)
  • Branded HTML emails and fully editable notification templates
  • Automation – escalation alerts, auto-close for stale tickets, follow-up reminders and daily or weekly digests
  • Knowledge base – per-company articles, categories, search, suggested articles and helpful voting
  • Chatbots – a no-code FAQ chatbot builder plus an AI chatbot trained on your knowledge base
  • AI assistant – automatic triage, reply suggestions, conversation summaries, sentiment detection, translation and duplicate detection
  • Integrations – WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, Zapier, CRM sync and issue trackers
  • Reporting – advanced ticket and agent reports, CSAT surveys and scheduled exports

Upgrading preserves all existing tickets, customers, agents and settings.

Get Pro
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Helpdesks > Configure Helpdesks to set the helpdesk name, the front-end URL slug, the colour theme and any usage limits.
  4. Visit YOURSITE.COM/company/ (or the slug you configured) to open the helpdesk front-end.
  5. Create your first helpdesk, then add agents and manage customers from the company admin panel.
sections.faq:
How do i view the support helpdesk

By default YOURSITE.COM/company displays the helpdesk homepage. You can change the URL slug from Helpdesks > Configure Helpdesks.

How many agents and tickets can i create

As many as you like. Limits are optional and configurable – set a limit to 0 for unlimited.

Does the helpdesk use my WordPress theme

The helpdesk front-end is a self-contained single page app, so it looks and behaves the same on any WordPress theme.

Can i change the colours

Yes. Pick from 6 built-in colour themes (Default, Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Royal, Slate) in Helpdesks > Configure Helpdesks.

Why should i buy the Pro version

The Pro upgrade is coming soon and will add SMS and chat notifications, a knowledge base, chatbots, AI powered replies and automation. Existing installations upgrade without losing data.

  • Responsive layouts across every screen
  • Usage limits for helpdesks, tickets, agents and customers
  • Admin Only Creation mode
